title_original: Peter Turnley : Paris Photographs Print Sale
excerpt_original: This holiday season, Peter Turnley is offering a choice of 30 of his iconic Paris photographs at exceptional prices, available exclusively during the holiday […] Cet article Peter Turnley : Paris Photographs Print Sale est apparu en premier sur The Eye of Photography Magazine .

blocks.text: This holiday season, Peter Turnley is offering a choice of 30 of his iconic Paris photographs at exceptional prices, available exclusively during the holiday print sale.

Each photograph is a traditional 12 x 16 inch (30 x 40 cm) silver gelatin fiber print, individually signed by Peter Turnley. This year’s selection includes many new photographs, alongside some of his most renowned images of Paris. Special holiday pricing is available for individual prints, with even greater savings when purchasing multiple photographs. Every order of three or more prints includes a complimentary signed copy of my book, Paris Je t’aime: 50 Years of Photographs.
This special one-time sale lasts until Wednesday December 2, Midnight EST. All prints ordered will be delivered by FedEx before Christmas day.
